summary: Phase 149O.19.5E.3 -- HMIC v1.1 24-File Production Identity Alignment: NARROW PRODUCTION CONTRACT-ALIGNMENT IMPLEMENTATION resolving the production half of Stop Condition W-1. Confirmed baseline via direct inspection: repo clean at phase entry (e0f64390), origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.19.5E.2 completed/complete/pushed, HMIC v1.1 frozen with contract 24-file set, production still 22-file (entering divergence reconstructed: contract-production delta = exactly {core/hatp_mandatory_certification.py, scripts/hatp_certification_admin.py}, production-contract delta = empty), hardcoded False unchanged, no readiness integration, no real certification state, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read docs/contracts/HATP_MANDATORY_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION_CERTIFICATION_CONTRACT.md Sec17 and src/pcae/core/hatp_mandatory_certification.py in full before editing. Modified exactly one production file: appended 'core/hatp_mandatory_certification.py' as the 19th entry of _FROZEN_SRC_PCAE_RELATIVE_FILES and 'scripts/hatp_certification_admin.py' as the 5th entry of _FROZEN_REPOSITORY_ROOT_RELATIVE_FILES, in the contract's own literal presentation order; changed the module-level count assertion from 22 to 24 (no permissive >=24); corrected five directly-adjacent comment blocks that described the very constants being changed (from '22'/'this module is deliberately NOT a member' to '24'/'this module IS now a member'), leaving genuinely historical narrative elsewhere in the same docstring untouched. No literal HMIC contract-version expectation exists in production (derive_contract_versions parses **Version:** headers dynamically; HMIC-001 itself is not among the four _CONTRACT_VERSIONS_REQUIRED_KEYS), so no change was needed or made there. Verified against the live repository (not only a synthetic fixture): production/contract frozen sets are now exactly equal (24/24, independently re-extracted from the live HMIC-REQ-050 enumeration, not copied from the production constant used as its own expected value); the other 23 frozen files are byte-unchanged since phase entry via direct git-show comparison; self-binding is real and non-circular (the core module's own post-edit bytes participate in the digest it computes, proven by mutating a temp copy and observing a digest change); admin-script and all-24-file mutation sensitivity (24/24 files individually change the digest on a one-byte modeled mutation); a historical 22-file-scope digest differs from the current 24-file-scope digest for an identical snapshot (v1.0-scope replay rejected); production's own derive_implementation_scope_digest matches an independently authored reimplementation of HMIC-REQ-054-058 over the live 24-file set (golden-style cross-check); derive_implementation_scope_digest accepts no caller-suppliable scope-override parameter; no legacy_scope/v1_0_compat/file_count=22/ignore_new_files token exists in production source. A whole-module AST function/class-source sweep against the phase-entry commit proved every function and class body in hatp_mandatory_certification.py -- including derive_implementation_scope_digest, _frozen_canonical_paths, _canonical_frozen_path, derive_implementation_commit, _run_git, _validate_at_root, the production validator entrypoint, the three Wave C writers, and the Wave A parsers/serializer -- is byte-identical to phase entry; only module-level statements (the two frozen-set tuples, the count assert, and their comments) changed. scripts/hatp_certification_admin.py and all eight bound contracts (HMIC-001 plus HMRC-001/HATP-001/HSCE-001/RAE-001/RWMPC-001/PBPA-001/PBPC-001) confirmed byte-unchanged. Hardcoded False readiness ceiling and zero readiness/cutover callers confirmed unchanged; no real certification state exists on host. Added tests/test_phase_149o_19_5e_3_hmic_v1_1_24_file_production_identity_alignment.py (29 tests). Updated tests/test_phase_149o_19_5b_hmic_identity_derivation.py (Wave B's own live regression suite; 22->24 count assertions and two tests recast from historical-v1.0 facts to current-v1.1 facts with docstrings preserving the v1.0 history) -- this suite was failing 1/26 at this phase's own entry commit (test_manifest_matches_contract_enumeration_exactly: production 22 != contract 24) and is fixed by this phase's alignment, mechanically confirming the divergence 149O.19.5E.1/E.2 identified was real and is now closed at the file-set level. Re-pinned 149O.19.5E.1's and 149O.19.5E.2's own 'production still 22'/'no src/pcae diff since entry' assertions from live-source/open-ended-HEAD comparisons to git show/git diff against each phase's own fixed exit commit, preserving historical evidence without rewriting any historical claim. While investigating Fast Green, discovered a repo-wide, HMIC-unrelated, pre-existing test fragility (first identified this phase): many historical phase test modules (149O.13 through 149O.19.4) assert 'no production file changed since my own entry commit' by diffing to a moving HEAD or an open-ended commit..HEAD range instead of their own phase's fixed exit commit, so any later legitimate change to a widely-referenced file trips them regardless of file ownership -- the identical defect class 149O.19.5E.1's own commit b701234b had already partially repaired for two unrelated modules. Repaired this pattern, following that exact precedent (pinning to each phase's own fixed exit commit, never weakening any assertion), in the six modules whose diff span legitimately needed to include this phase's own change window: test_phase_149o_19_4_hmic_implementation_plan_completeness.py, test_phase_149o_16_hatp_mandatory_consumption_contract_independent_verification.py, test_phase_149o_16_2_publication_timestamp_compatibility_independent_verification.py, test_phase_149o_17_hmrc_implementation_plan_completeness.py, test_phase_149o_18a_hatp_mandatory_cutover_state_foundation.py, test_phase_149o_18b_hatp_mandatory_evidence_consumption_adapter.py.
